Simulated phenotypic data for multivariate QTL mapping

Source: R/genoMVsim.R
phenoMVsim.Rd

Phenotypic data for the simulated DH mapping population genoMVsim, comprising 120 lines evaluated across eight field trials in a two-replicate design (1920 observations total).

Yield was simulated from a multivariate linear mixed model with:

  • A polygenic background drawn from \(\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},\, \mathbf{G}_a \otimes \mathbf{K})\), where \(\mathbf{G}_a\) is an 8 \(\times\) 8 genetic (co)variance matrix and \(\mathbf{K}\) is the genomic relationship matrix.

  • Four planted QTL (two main-effect, two G×E interaction) with effect sizes of approximately 3–4% of the trait mean. See genoMVsim for QTL positions and types.

  • Trial-specific residual variances of 0.80 and site means ranging from approximately 10 to 12.5 yield units.

Usage

phenoMVsim

Format

A data frame with 1920 rows and 4 columns:

id

Factor. Line identifier ("DH001" to "DH120").

Trial

Factor with levels Trial1 to Trial8.

Rep

Factor with levels R1 and R2.

yield

Numeric. Simulated grain yield (arbitrary units).

See also

genoMVsim, primeCross, qtlAim

Examples

data(phenoMVsim, package = "wgAim")
head(phenoMVsim)
#>      id  Trial Rep    yield
#> 1 DH001 Trial1  R1 12.70109
#> 2 DH002 Trial1  R1 12.12199
#> 3 DH003 Trial1  R1 13.82352
#> 4 DH004 Trial1  R1 11.75949
#> 5 DH005 Trial1  R1 14.11264
#> 6 DH006 Trial1  R1 12.34686
tapply(phenoMVsim$yield, phenoMVsim$Trial, mean)
#>    Trial1    Trial2    Trial3    Trial4    Trial5    Trial6    Trial7    Trial8 
#> 12.195497 12.275467 10.321033 11.957486 11.471098 11.040846 11.766529  9.929013
